_meta.what: k4's public plugin registry: what can be installed with tools/plugins.py --search / --install.
_meta.publish: Open a PR adding your entry: id, title, description, repo (git), commit (the full 40-char SHA you want published) and, if the plugin does not live at the repo root, folder. The keys `autor` and `carpeta` are read as aliases for author and folder, so entries written before the rename keep working.
_meta.commit: A COMMIT is published, not a branch. What was reviewed is exactly what gets installed, and a branch that moves later changes nothing for the people who installed it. To publish a new version, another PR with the new SHA.
